# Anvil Cloud

Anvil Cloud is an alpha TypeScript platform for Anvil Cells and contract-first
Agents. It is local-first, capability-scoped, and adapter-driven. Do not treat
it as a raw AWS authoring surface.

Full agent instructions: `llms-full.txt`.

## Start Here

- `README.md`: project overview.
- `AGENTS.md`: repo rules for coding agents.
- `docs/specs/alpha-implementation-spec.md`: alpha scope.
- `docs/specs/cell-contract.md`: Anvil Cell contract.
- `docs/specs/cli.md`: CLI and stable JSON contracts.
- `docs/architecture/agents.md`: Anvil Agent contract.
- `docs/architecture/runtime.md`: runtime design.
- `docs/architecture/builder.md`: Builder and Guard design.
- `docs/architecture/local-dev.md`: Anvil Local and Lens.
- `docs/architecture/aws-adapter.md`: AWS preview adapter.

## Non-Negotiable Rules

- Cell code must default-export `app(...)` from `src/cell.server.ts`.
- Cell code uses Anvil runtime primitives: `ctx.db`, `ctx.files`, `ctx.env`,
  `ctx.log`, `ctx.jobs`, `ctx.workflows`, and global `fetch` only with a
  declared `capabilities.outboundFetch.allow` host.
- Cell code must not import AWS SDKs, Pulumi, CDK, SST, Terraform/CDKTF,
  Kubernetes clients, Docker clients, Node filesystem modules for app data, or
  direct network modules such as `http`, `https`, `net`, `tls`, or `undici`.
- Cell code must not read `process.env` directly. Declare `capabilities.env`
  or `capabilities.secrets` and use `ctx.env.get` or `ctx.env.require`.
- Public automation commands must support `--json`; prefer JSON output in
  agent workflows.
- Effect is internal to Anvil Cloud orchestration only. Do not expose Effect in
  Cell authoring APIs or examples.

## Useful Commands

```sh
anvil-cloud new notes
anvil-cloud check --json
anvil-cloud build --json
anvil-cloud dev --json
anvil-cloud inspect --local --json
anvil-cloud logs --local --json
anvil-cloud doctor --json
anvil-cloud review --json
```

From the monorepo checkout, run commands inside `anvil-cloud/` and use the
workspace script or built entrypoint:

```sh
pnpm anvil-cloud --help
node packages/cli/dist/index.js check --json
```
